d:
Tune in to this romantic song "Chehre Pe Giri Zulfein" from the super hit movie Suraj (1966) starring Rajendra Kumar and Vyjayanthimala in the lead only on Rajshri.
Song: Chehre Pe Giri Zulfein
Movie: Suraj (1966)
Singer: Mohammad Rafi
Music: Shankar Jaikishan
Lyricist: Hasrat Jaipuri
Cast: Vyjayanthimala, Rajendra Kumar, Ajit, Mumtaz, Johnny Walker
Director: T. Prakash Rao
